Menu.MinimumLuck.Help: Desired luck tomorrow, from -0.100 to +0.100, excluding the Special Charm. +0.100 is the maximum; -0.100 accepts any luck. The mod searches for a step count that meets the target without changing luck directly.
Menu.Dish.Help: Choose a possible Saloon dish. Luck, dish and minimum stock must all match. Any dish disables the dish and quantity filters.
Menu.DishAmount.Help: Minimum quantity sold tomorrow, from 1 to 13. Only applies when a dish is selected.
Menu.SearchSteps.Help: How many counts to test starting from your current steps. Higher limits help combine luck and dish targets but take more work to calculate. The panel shows the TOTAL step count to reach.
Menu.PositionX.Help: Distance from the left edge in UI pixels. The window stays on screen with an 8-pixel margin.
Menu.PositionY.Help: Distance from the top edge in UI pixels. The window stays on screen with an 8-pixel margin.
Menu.Width.Help: Width in pixels before scaling, from 240 to 1,200. Height follows the text automatically.
Menu.Scale.Help: Overall size from 50% to 200%. The effective scale is reduced if needed to fit the content on screen.
Menu.Panel.Help: Height adjusts to the text. Save your changes and return to the game to check the position and size.
Hud.Lightning: Storm: before 11 pm, overnight lightning can change the predicted luck.
